title: Existence of equal open
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $F$ be a sheaf of sets on $S_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets]. Let $V\to S$ be an object of $S_{\Et}$ and $s,t\in F(V)$. For a morphism of schemes $a:T\to V$ with composite $e:T\to V\to S$, write $s|_T\in(e^{-1}F)(T)$ for the restriction of $e^*s\in(e^{-1}F)(V\times_ST)$ [lem-weil-pbc-sets-etale-inverse-image-composition-units] along the $T$-morphism $(a,\mathrm{id}_T):T\to V\times_ST$. Then there is an open subscheme $W\subset V$ such that a morphism $a:T\to V$ factors through $W$ if and only if $s|_T=t|_T$.

proof.text: Construct the subterminal agreement sheaf H on V and its inhabited-stalk criterion.
Apply existsUnique_open_of_etale_subsheaf_final to H. Its geometric stalk clause identifies membership in the resulting W with equality of the original section germs.

For a:T to V, compare the germ of each unit-pulled-back section restricted along (a,id) with the original germ at y followed by a. Germ naturality, the pullback projection identities, and injectivity of the inverse-image stalk comparison give an equivalence of the two germ equalities.

If a factors through W, all original germs agree and hence all pulled-back germs agree. Apply etaleSetSection_ext_of_geometric_germs to the identity object of T; every pointed identity object is Over.homMk y (Category.comp_id y), by Over.OverMorphism.ext and Over.w. Thus the global sections agree. Conversely, equality implies every algebraic-closure point maps into W; algClosurePoint_base gives image containment, and IsOpenImmersion.lift factors a through W.
